(A) EXECUTED: (1) actually run scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1 once in a real fresh process on this machine (including its internal agent-bootstrap checks and bounded dry-run); (2) write the command line, working directory, start/end timestamps, exit code, raw stdout/stderr excerpt and parsed summary into .ai/results/ERP-084.json under raw_script_invocation together with effective_provider, effective_model, agent_bootstrap.parse_errors, agent_bootstrap.fast_forward_merge_present, agent_bootstrap.path_conflict_check_present, agent_bootstrap.repair_deferred_browser_present, bounded_dry_run.python_exit_code, bounded_dry_run.output, queue_head, erp074_resumable, conclusion; (3) in the SAME commit restore .ai/tasks/ERP-074.json..ERP-077.json from failed(attempts=3) to retryable (status=pending or retry plus an explicit attempts_reset_reason) preserving acceptance_criteria/allowed_paths/depends_on/browser_acceptance verbatim; (4) update .ai/PROJECT_STATE.json so CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED.recovery_task=ERP-084 and recovery_evidence=.ai/results/ERP-084.json, WITHOUT clearing AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER, keeping rolling_queue.status=blocked_on_control_plane_verification and queued_tasks containing only ERP-084.

Doc-only closure (any commit that edits control-plane JSON text without the raw_script_invocation field) is explicitly declared NOT accepted by this task. No further isomorphic control-plane recovery task may be issued, and no silent quarantine loop is permitted. Do not implement ERP business logic, do not touch any file under src/ERP.*, do not access or change production database/OSS, do not deploy or release, and keep LIVE_TRADING=false and ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false.
